notificationSwitches.title: Notification Switches
notificationSwitches.description: Allows to configure multiple HomeKit switches to play notifications.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the switch to be added to HomeKit.

trackUri.title: Track URI
trackUri.description: The URI of the notification to be played. Must be WAV or MP3.

sonosDeviceNames.title: Sonos Device Names
sonosDeviceNames.description: The names of the Sonos devices this notification should be played on.

items.title: Device Name
items.description: Name of a Sonos device in your local network.

onlyWhenPlaying.title: Only When Playing
onlyWhenPlaying.description: Only play this notification, if the device is already playing.

trackSwitches.title: Track Switches
trackSwitches.description: Allows to configure multiple HomeKit switches to play entire tracks or streams.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the switch to be added to HomeKit.

trackUri.title: Track URI
trackUri.description: The URI of the track to be played. Can be any kind of track / stream URI Sonos supports.

sonosDeviceNames.title: Sonos Device Names
sonosDeviceNames.description: The names of the Sonos devices this track should be played on.

items.title: Device Name
items.description: Name of a Sonos device in your local network.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Volume of the track to be played. If left empty, the current volume of the device is used.

seekPosition.title: Seek
seekPosition.description: Jump to the given position in the track. Format: hh:mm:ss

stopAfter.title: Stop Playing After
stopAfter.description: Stop playing after the given amount of seconds.

sonosDeviceIp.title: Sonos Device IP
sonosDeviceIp.description: If auto discovery of Sonos devices fails in your local network, enter the IP of any Sonos device. For this to work reliably, a static IP should be assigned to this device.
